bull.b: Regaining full development and commercial rights is a structural shift that consolidates upside from seralutinib, lets Gossamer control pricing, manufacturing and launch sequencing, and preserves future royalties/milestones that would otherwise flow to a partner; this materially improves long-term economics and strategic optionality.
